title: Remove the console's leftover reads of the retired view columnState key (after #36403)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT24Rn8qK81aEFebXj

Follow-up from #36403 (PR #36435). Found by the dev's census and the L1 on PR #36435 (L1 7078961706). Parent: #36403.

## What is left

PR #36435 retires `columnState` from the stored `view` row: a stored row is served without it, and a save that carries it is refused. The console never needed an edit to keep working, because every reader below now reads `undefined`. But four places in `ui/` still read or describe it as a live view key. One of them is hidden behind `as any`, so no gate will find it again.

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx:787`: `columnState: viewPref?.columnState ?? (viewDef as any).columnState ?? (listSchema as any).columnState ?? {}`. The two `as any` rungs read the retired view key and are always `undefined` now. Drop them and keep `viewPref?.columnState ?? {}`. (#36370 also edits this file: land after it, or rebase onto it.)
2. `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3349`: `'columnState'` in `VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS`. A stored overlay row is served without the key, so the entry narrows nothing. Remove it, and fix the docblock above it that describes it as a live key (lines 3301 and 3328, the `columnState`'s admission … runtime-only overlay key sentence), plus the same list in the comments at 3227 and 6468, and `VIEW_ITEM_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` in the comment at 6503.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts:502`: the docblock names "`columnState`, the runtime-only key the spec declares on the ViewItem wire face" and "the column widths the row held". The key is gone from `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`, so the envelope no longer carries it. Update the text, and the list at line 233.
4. Any pin that still names the key as an overlay-owned key (`VIEW_OVERLAY_OWNED_KEYS` tests in `data-objectstack`).

Not in scope: `columnState` as the grid's runtime prop (`plugin-grid`, `ObjectGrid`, `ListView`, `RelatedList`) and in user preferences (`personalViews.ts`, `RecordPagePreferences`). Those are a different shape, not the view key.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n columnState ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` finds only the reader's own layout (`viewPref?.columnState`) and the grid prop.
- `Type Check UI` and the `data-objectstack` / `app-shell` view tests are green.

Blocked-by: #36435 (the spec retirement must be on `main` first)

## Grade
p3 · area:ux · domain:ui. Dead code and stale comments with no user-visible harm. It is filed so the `as any` rung does not outlive the key it reads.
